definitions.explanation: A needle used for hand sewing, with an eye at one end for thread. From {縫|ぬ}う (to sew) plus {針|はり} (needle).

examples.japanese: {縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}に{糸|いと}を{通|とお}す。
{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}で{指|ゆび}を{刺|さ}してしまった。
examples.english: I pricked my finger with a sewing needle.

examples.japanese: ボタンを{付|つ}けるために{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}と{糸|いと}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I got a sewing needle and thread ready to attach the button.

notes:
From {縫|ぬ}う (to sew) plus {針|はり} (needle); the は voices to ば in the compound (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}に{糸|いと}を{通|とお}す: to thread a sewing needle
- {太|ふと}い{縫|ぬ}い{針|ばり}: a thick sewing needle

RELATED WORDS:
- {編|あ}み{針|ばり}: knitting needle
- {針箱|はりばこ}: sewing box
